visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Move decoration from HTML to CSS
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each item starts with a typed arrow in the HTML. Move the arrow to a ::before rule so the text only has the words. The visible line must read the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
-> Open the box

-> Read the guide

solution.code:
Open the box

Read the guide
solution.explanation: A marker that is only decoration does not belong in the content. In CSS it can be changed in one place, and it is not read out as text by a screen reader.
